Repeat Measurements participant flag thresholds

Source: R/rm_Classify.R
rm_FlagThresholds.Rd

Amber and Red thresholds for a participant flag rule. Count thresholds default to 2 and 3 repeating windows. Rate thresholds default to the `kri0020` metric thresholds so that the participant flag matches the site KRI, or 0.2 and 0.3 without them.

Usage

rm_FlagThresholds(
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  dfMetrics = NULL
)

Arguments

strFlagRule

`character` `"count"` (repeating windows) or `"rate"` (share of windows that repeat).

vFlagThresholds

`numeric` Amber then Red threshold, or `NULL` for the defaults. Rates are fractions.

dfMetrics

`data.frame` Metric metadata with `ID` and `Threshold`.

Value

A `numeric` vector: Amber, then Red.
